EdwCustomTableConfig.CreateViewQuery:
CREATE VIEW [InternationalLogistics].[vw_CUS__ShipmentParentIDs] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
SELECT ShipmentParentKey = S.ShipmentKey, JS = S.ShipmentID, ParentID = S.ShipmentID FROM InternationalLogistics.BAS__Shipment S
UNION ALL
SELECT ShipmentParentKey = S.ShipmentKey, JS = S.ShipmentID, ParentID = D.DeclarationID FROM InternationalLogistics.BAS__Shipment S JOIN Customs.BAS__Declaration D ON D.JobShipmentKey = S.ShipmentKey
UNION ALL
SELECT ShipmentParentKey = S.ShipmentKey, JS = S.ShipmentID, ParentID = E.EntryHeaderID FROM InternationalLogistics.BAS__Shipment S JOIN Customs.BAS__Declaration D ON D.JobShipmentKey = S.ShipmentKey JOIN Customs.BAS__EntryHeader E ON E.DeclarationKey = D.DeclarationKey
UNION ALL
SELECT ShipmentParentKey = H.HouseAirWayBillKey, JS = S.ShipmentID, ParentID = M.MasterAirWayBillID FROM Customs.BAS__HouseAirWayBill H LEFT JOIN InternationalLogistics.BAS__Shipment S ON H.JobShipmentKey = S.ShipmentKey LEFT JOIN Customs.BAS__MasterAirWayBill M ON H.MasterAirWayBillKey = M.MasterAirWayBillKey
